title: Study to Assess the Safety & Tolerability of a PARP Inhibitor in Combination With Gemcitabine in Pancreatic Cancer
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to identify a safe and tolerable dose of the drug KU-0059436 that can be given in combination with gemcitabine chemotherapy for the treatment of pancreatic cancer.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of pancreas
* Locally advanced or metastatic unresectable disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* No prior anti cancer chemotherapy, radiotherapy (except palliative \>4 weeks prior to entry, endocrine or immunotherapy or use of other investigational agents;
